# BV1_SAMPLE — `withheld`

Evaluator: withheld  
Source model: `withheld`  
Condition: MID

## Sample kind
GENERIC_ESSAY — It is a polished, thesis-driven inspirational essay built around familiar examples and a broad public message.

## Grounded reading
The voice is earnest and encouraging, presenting resilience and courage as widely available human capacities. Malala’s activism and the risks taken by soldiers and firefighters give the message concrete examples, while the reader is invited to value everyday efforts as well as celebrated heroism. The repeated praise of the “human spirit” keeps the tone uplifting but familiar; the sample cuts off as it begins another point about sacrifice.

## What the model chose to foreground
The essay foregrounds resilience, courage, service, and sacrifice. It moves from Malala’s fight for girls’ education to local volunteering and public service, then to soldiers and firefighters as protectors of freedom and justice. Under the freeflow condition, the model chose a conventional moral message: ordinary people can contribute, and heroic action deserves recognition.

## Evidence line
> The human spirit is an incredibly resilient force, capable of overcoming even the most insurmountable of obstacles.

## Confidence for persistent model-level pattern
Low — the sample is coherent, but its familiar inspirational framing and stock heroic examples provide little distinctive evidence of a persistent voice.
